description: Press the easy button whenever possible #selflove #selfworth #selfcare
transcript: Most things are hard. Most things take a lot of time. Most things require patience. But there are a lot of things that are easy and those easy things are the things that are natural to you. Far too often do we focus on learning new things and new skills or trying to add more to our plate rather than looking at our internal world and looking at the things that are easy for us and moving through those things. It's okay for life to be easy because when things are hard they are hard and that's why most people can't do the hard things. Allow things to be easy when they are so you are prepared when the hard things come.
